text: What should the gun-based Healing effect do on contact?
suggestions: Heal allied fighters hit by the projectile; the base weapon still damages hostile contacts, so collision/aim presentation explicitly distinguishes ally-heal and enemy-damage contacts. (Recommended)
Heal the shooter when their weapon damages a hostile target (lifesteal), avoiding allied projectile collision.
Replace damage with healing and make the configured weapon an ally-only healing weapon while the module is equipped.

text: How should players obtain separate Cold, Poison, and Fire resistances?
suggestions: Add three mutually exclusive resistance passives that compete for the existing two passive slots. (Recommended)
Author different innate resistances on the three immutable fighter profiles.
Model and expose the three resistance stats now with equal defaults, but defer player-selectable resistance content.

text: What should Freeze prevent during its short active window?
suggestions: Root movement and reject primary/ultimate activation while still allowing facing/aim; interrupt an active Dash. (Recommended)
Root movement only; allow primary fire and ultimates.
Apply a very strong slow instead of a complete root or action lock.
